identity_rule: Wardrobe may evolve by era, but must preserve Luzaria's warm-neutral street-luxury identity, effortless femininity, and SGV grounding without caricature or costume.

beauty.hair: Very long dark brown to soft black, full movement, never hidden by the look
beauty.makeup: Soft brown smoked liner, warm skin, nude-brown lip, full voluminous lashes
beauty.jewelry: Medium aged-gold hoops, fine layered chain, one signet ring

sleep_on_the_floor.story: She is exhausted, grieving, and still standing between danger and her children. The clothes read as protection built from ordinary life—not fantasy armor.

hero_look.outerwear: Toast-brown cropped leather moto jacket with structured shoulders, softened wear at the seams, and a warm-cream quilted lining visible at the collar
hero_look.top: Smoke-black ribbed square-neck bodysuit with full coverage and a clean close fit
hero_look.bottom: Oxblood-black wide-leg utility trousers in matte satin twill, high waist, reinforced knee panels, and subtle aged-gold hardware
hero_look.footwear: Black leather square-toe platform boots with a stable block heel and brushed-metal side zip
accessories: Fine layered chain with a small LZR identity plate
hero_look.hair: Long, loose, slightly wind-tossed, center part; one side tucked behind the ear
hero_look.makeup: Soft smoked brown eyes, warm skin, nude-brown lip, visible tiredness preserved rather than airbrushed away

performance_variant.outerwear: Jacket removed after the first chorus and carried or placed nearby, revealing vulnerability without changing identity
performance_variant.top_layer: Warm-cream fitted thermal under the black bodysuit for close-up texture at sleeves and neckline
performance_variant.movement_rule: Nothing fragile, restrictive, or ornamental enough to distract from the testimony

cover_art_direction.setting: Small carpeted room at night with one window, subtle streetlamp hum implied through amber light
cover_art_direction.pose: Seated low near the floor, shoulders forward, one hand braced behind her, gaze directly into camera
cover_art_direction.lighting: Amber streetlight from one side, cool window shadow from the other, restrained film grain
cover_art_direction.title_treatment: SLEEP ON THE FLOOR in narrow warm-cream type; LUZARIA smaller in aged gold
